fusions.name: Branching Snare
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh crusted with sharp growth that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Atoll Rising
fusions.desc: Your mesh hardens into a ring of branching reef around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Crusted Over
fusions.desc: Grows a crust of reef over the mesh you wear, raising your armour by 25% for 11 seconds.

fusions.name: Living Lattice
fusions.desc: The mesh you wear grows into living reef: your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
